observations.note: "Nõustun kokkuleppega" was enabled for both participants before the case bringer had confirmed the settings, and pressing it answered 409 with the generic "Kovisiooni salvestamine ebaõnnestus." (local-ui-covision-raw2.json). After the settings were confirmed the same step answered 200.
After each confirmation the session saves and returns to part 1 (Ühine laud); the next confirmation needs the Ring part reopened.

The invitee is not shown the invitation anywhere in the app; the session is reached only through the e-mailed link /kovisioon?case=<id>, and the e-mail is sent by the notification job (CovisionInviteDelivery PENDING, attempts 0). On the server that job is refused by the closed gate (server-jobs-and-deadline.json), so covision invitations would not reach anyone there while the platform is closed. Inference from the two measurements; no server invitation was sent.
Audio, microphone refusal, reconnection and participant removal were not tested: headless browser without a microphone.
